title: The Health Connect page says only workouts logged in MettleUp are sent, but imported workouts are sent too
what: Under Send past workouts the app says only workouts logged in MettleUp are sent. But workouts brought in from a Hevy or Strong file are sent to Health Connect by themselves right after the import, whenever sending is on. And when the phone cannot tell when MettleUp first ran, every workout on the phone is sent, old ones included, with no such line. The data only goes to Health Connect on the member's own phone, so nothing reaches another company, but the line tells the member something that is not true.
expected: The words under Send past workouts match what is really sent: they also name imported workouts, or imported workouts follow the same rule.
who: members who send workouts to Health Connect and import a Hevy or Strong file
how_often: every import while Health Connect sending is on
fix_line: Change the line to say imported workouts are sent too, or hold imported workouts back the same way.

title: Weigh-ins from Health Connect would reach the gym and an AI if two switched-off features came back
what: Weigh-ins read from Health Connect go into the same body-weight log as typed ones, with no lasting mark of where they came from. Two features that are switched off today read the newest body weight from that log: the old gym sync puts it in a summary the gym's dashboard shows in its member list, and the AI coach gets it in its day snapshot. The privacy notice promises Health Connect data never goes to the gym or to any AI, and the gym table in the notice does not list body weight at all. Nothing is sent today because both switches are off.
expected: Before either feature is turned on again, weigh-ins that came from Health Connect are left out of what goes to the gym and to the AI, or the notice and Health Connect's rules allow it.
who: members who let MettleUp read weight from Health Connect
how_often: only if gym sync or the AI coach is switched back on
fix_line: Keep a mark on weigh-ins from Health Connect and leave them out of anything sent to the gym or an AI; add a test that blocks it.

items.reason: P-A7-phone-watch-3-05 kept: every Health Connect send goes through one step that stops on demo data (and treats an unreadable check as demo); the cloud copy and gym sync also stop on demo data. P-A7-phone-watch-3-06 broken: imported workouts are sent too, and all workouts go when the first-run time is unknown (01).

Notice: Health Connect's permission screen opens the privacy notice in the browser. Consent: each Health Connect read and write is off until the member says yes on Health Connect's own screen, each with its own switch; Stop and remove takes every permission back and says what stays. Purpose: steps and sleep are only shown, never stored. Deletion: see L4.6. Breach timing and children: nothing of that kind in this area. Gap: Health Connect weigh-ins carry no lasting mark, so their purpose limit is not enforced in code (02).
This area is the phone's own native code and phone helpers; MettleUp staff have no view into it and no read log runs here. No entity with personal data or reader is listed for this area.

Sleep and steps are read and shown only, never stored. Health Connect bookkeeping on the phone is capped (owed workouts list, seen weigh-in ids) and cleared on erase. Workouts already sent stay in Health Connect after Stop or erase, and both screens say so. No data kept longer than promised found.

Outside sends in this area: workouts to Health Connect (in the notice); the gym logo is fetched for the home-screen shortcut; Play billing and in-app update go through Google Play; the watch gets the live workout through Google Play services on the member's own devices (in the notice). No analytics, no AI and no WhatsApp in this area. Latent gap: Health Connect weigh-ins would reach the gym dashboard and the AI coach if gym sync or the coach came back on (02).

Erase all data resets the phone side (Health Connect sending, weight and sleep reading off, reminders, widgets, shortcuts), but only after three other refreshes, and a failure there skips it (existing finding reused). Workouts already in Health Connect stay there; the erase and Stop screens tell the member to remove them in Health Connect. Account delete on the server is outside this area.
